name: Gemini
purpose: Gemini aims to revolutionize natural language processing and human-computer interactions by offering versatile capabilities across different modalities. It solves complex problems and enhances productivity by providing advanced AI assistance for a wide range of tasks.
coreComponents: Input encoders for various modalities (text, image, audio, video, code)
Output heads for generating different formats (text, JSON, tool calls, code)
Containment-First Architecture for secure agent execution
keyCapabilities: Multimodal understanding (text, images, audio, video, code)
Long context window processing (up to 10 million tokens for 1.5 models)
integrations: Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Meet)
Google Cloud (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Colab Enterprise, Application Integration)
Third-party apps and services (e.g., Asana, Mailchimp via Workspace Marketplace)
useCases: Text generation and content creation (e.g., articles, emails, marketing copy)
Data analysis, summarization, and insight generation from various documents (PDFs, financial statements, legal documents, videos)
Automating workflows and building custom AI agents

researchPapers.title: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
Gemini 1.5: Unlocking multimodal understanding across millions of tokens of context
Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities
